causes: ARM FMAX/FMIN propagate NaNs; RVV maxNumber/minNumber retain the numeric operand when only one operand is NaN.
changes: Use real RVV self-NaN masks and vector merges for propagating min/max.
Create separate bit-preserving value copies for each repeated comparison operand. No scalar b!=b or NaN literal helper.
Preserve original nine-FMA order, row/column/VL loops, reverse o2/o1/o0 store order and all alias/tail paths.

Move the two actual ordinary C helpers into shim/propagating.c behind a public typed API; formal-only pointer borrow adapters preserve all input cells. Main C arithmetic/loop/store tokens retained after the NaN repair.

Hoist exactly58 nested pure local-vector calls to named const temporaries at the original statement. Intrinsic call counts and all FMA/store/control order retained; lvalue-only borrow frontend is buildable. This is an explicit compatibility implementation variant, with original-C equivalence not asserted as a whole theorem.

Wrap46 scalar loads at their original evaluation sites in ordinary dw_read_scalar(&lvalue), whose actual C body returns *p and preserves the shared read map. This case-local compatible variant retains conditional evaluation and each FMA/store/control order; it does not exempt an adapter as an intrinsic.
scope: Full FP32 values/bounds and unordered bounds; numeric equality or bothNaN. FP flags unobserved/traps disabled; no physical ISA/ABI refinement claim.
reference_only: Frama candidate preserved separately, not copied with its dimension/separation cuts or scalar selfcompare. Arcadia target equals original.
native_scope: Finite actual C through three legalVL modes/two inactive choices with independent scalar exact-fused oracle, read aliases/frame, wrongone/both controls. Not formal proof or hardware execution.

neon_compatibility.reason: QCP rejects local static storage (actual fatal/zero VC preserved). Only static removed from never-escaping read-only 7-int constant table; identical initializer/use sites, no new branch/domain restriction.
